description: Weak, diffuse unit with no clean concept found. It fires most often just after the opponent drops a stone into the third row (row 2) of a centre column (2-5), on top of one of my stones, early in the game while no column is taller than 3. Many such positions do not fire, and many firings are mid- or late-game positions without this pattern.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to zero or max changes no column's probability by more than 0.03.
notes: Tried: last_row==2 plus an early-game cap (F1 .16); centre columns with my stone below (.16); tallest column <=3 (.17); all combined (.195, AUROC .58). Minimal pairs are context dependent: the XXO col-3 stack fires robustly in one family, but 0/14 random ply-6 positions with O on col 3 row 2 fired. The activation falls once later moves are added, so it is tied to the last move. Steer effect ~0. Possibly a random direction.
